text: Compressor yard, segment 14 pressure sensor housing: initially asked for just a tally of the corrosion blisters visible on the flange imagery. Supervisor has since changed the ask, we need each blister boxed and positioned in the frame instead. Imagery stays inside the facility for processing, and baseline accuracy is perfectly acceptable.

hey, can you read the numbers off the engine room gauge photos from the MV Aurora? ordinary accuracy should do, no rush on it either. actually, on accuracy, the chief engineer says misread digits will wreck the fuel logs, so it has to be the sharpest model you've got

The Provider shall locate every student passing through the bus doorway in onboard cabin imagery and return a bounding rectangle for each person found. Baseline model accuracy was agreed as acceptable at contract signature. Following the district transport board's review of 12 March, that allowance is withdrawn and the Provider shall apply its most accurate available model tier. Jobs under this clause shall be expedited ahead of all other queued work.

CleanWatch alert, Suite 3B: new request to return a single count of particle counters showing a red alarm lamp in the latest snapshot. Update from QA lead, 09:42: drop the count, we need the digits and lot code on each counter's display transcribed instead. Default model accuracy is fine for this job.

Hey, read out the lettering on the gangway warning signs from the latest ramp footage. Wait, the harbour master says forget the signs, mark where each passenger is on the ramp with a box instead. Use your best-accuracy model for that, and there's no hurry, the regular queue is fine.

Hi team, I asked last week for the batch labels on our fermentation tanks to be transcribed from the cellar photos. Our head brewer has since pointed out that those labels already live in the ERP, so what we really need is each foam overflow located, with a box drawn around every spill in the image. Thanks, Marta

Reefer van 22, cargo bay interior cam: original request was to put boxes around each pallet in the hold. Dispatcher changed that after the audit, what we actually need is the temperature log sticker on each pallet read and transcribed. Accuracy must be top-tier on this one, misread numbers void the shipment.

yo, for the platform screen door stills at Central, i first said just give me how many doors are stuck open as one number. talked to maintenance and they'd rather have the fault codes printed on each door panel read out instead lol. fine to push the images to an offsite server, but make it the most accurate model, they don't want guessed characters

Section 4.2 (Stop-Arm Compliance). The Contractor shall identify vehicles passing a deployed stop arm in exterior footage from district buses and mark each vehicle's position within the frame by a rectangular box. Under the original schedule, ordinary detection accuracy was deemed adequate; per Amendment 2, requested by the Safety Committee, the Contractor shall instead deliver results at its top-grade accuracy. Such requests carry routine scheduling and are not time-sensitive.

FlareGuard | Platform Delta-7: count request opened for the number of active flare tips visible in the stack imagery, single figure only, with footage held on the platform's own server. Update from OIM: shore-side processing is now approved, so the imagery may be sent to the onshore cloud. Flagged priority, move it to the front of the queue.

Okay, tell me how many totes are stacked on the AGV in bay nine, just the number, and keep the footage on our local box. Actually, IT just said it's fine to run it on the vendor's cloud, so go ahead and send it out. Regular accuracy is plenty for this.

Hi Priya, For the aisle scans from store 118, please put a box around every gap on the shelves so our replenishment team can see exactly where stock is missing. I originally said the images had to be processed inside the store and never leave it. Legal has now cleared us to upload them to an external processing service, so that restriction no longer applies. Cheers, Tom

Stadium gate 4 turnstiles: need the ticket serials read off the scanner snapshots, baseline accuracy is enough. Logged this as a no-rush item this morning. Ops manager bumped it after the gate jam, it now needs to be processed as top priority before kickoff.

can you tally how many containers are on the crane's lift frames today, just a number? i told you earlier it's cool to process the crane footage in the cloud, but the terminal security guy just vetoed that, it has to stay on the quay servers. oh and use the best model you have, the count feeds billing

Under Clause 7.1, the Service shall extract the printed manifest numbers from photographs of inbound freight taken at the border checkpoint scanner station. At the request of the Border Agency liaison, Clause 7.1 is amended as follows. The Service shall instead identify each parcel within the scanner imagery and enclose it within a bounding frame indicating its location. Baseline accuracy shall be deemed sufficient for all outputs under this clause.

AGV Fleet Hub: task created to report how many pallets AGV-12 carried past dock 3, as a single total. Edited by the floor lead: ignore the total, transcribe the SKU labels printed on each pallet instead. Queue position: regular, not time-critical.

Hey, find the hot spots on transformer two in the thermal images and draw a box around each one, and do it right away, it's a rush. Oh, never mind the rush, the engineer says the readings are steady, so the regular queue is fine.

Hello, Could you process the overnight imagery from the lamp-post sensors on Harbour Road and mark every parked vehicle with a box showing its position? Baseline accuracy will do for this. In my earlier message I asked you to fast-track it, but the council meeting was postponed, so please treat it as a regular request with no time pressure. Best regards, Hana

OR 5 air-quality sensor panel: first request was to box and locate each filter cartridge in the panel photo. Biomed clarified they just need the pressure and humidity values on the panel's LCD transcribed. Images come from a patient area and must be processed within the hospital; default accuracy is acceptable.

quick one, can you count the flare stacks lit up in last night's platform pics and just send me the total? hold on, Dave says what he really wants is the ID stencils on each stack read out, not a count. ok to run it on the onshore servers, and no hurry at all

The Operator shall analyse drone imagery of turbine blades and delineate each surface defect, including cracks, leading-edge erosion and lightning strikes, with a rectangular region marking its location. Baseline inference accuracy is acceptable for these analyses. Notwithstanding the preceding sentence, following the asset owner's instruction dated 3 June, all such analyses shall be performed at the maximum accuracy tier offered by the Operator.

SiteSafe: entrance scanner job queued to read the worker ID printed on each helmet sticker. Revised by site safety officer: no IDs needed, just report how many helmets pass the entrance as one figure. Footage must not leave the site's local server; use the most accurate model available.

Read the heart rate and oxygen numbers off the bedside monitor photo from ward six, basic accuracy is fine. Wait, the charge nurse says these go into the chart, so use your most precise model instead.

Hi Rob, Earlier I asked for boxes around every haul truck in the pit-edge footage so we could see where each one was queuing. After talking with the dispatch supervisor, we only need to know how many trucks are waiting at the crusher, as a single number. There's no rush, the usual turnaround is fine. Thanks, Leila

Crop drone survey, north paddocks: read the tag numbers printed on the irrigation valve markers from the aerial stills. Initially flagged for top-accuracy processing, but the agronomist says plain accuracy is good enough since the tags are large. OK to send the stills to a cloud service for processing.

need a tally of how many pressure transmitters on the manifold are showing the red fault light, just the number. i said before that the photos can't leave the plant, but compliance got back to me and it's fine to process them off-site now

4.3 Twistlock Monitoring. The Provider shall detect each twistlock in spreader-mounted imagery and report its position by means of an enclosing box. Such requests were originally classified as routine and not time-sensitive. Pursuant to the terminal operator's notice following the lifting incident of 2 August, they are reclassified as priority and shall be processed ahead of all other pending requests.

Ridgeline Tower 2: job created to count the heat signatures in the thermal sweep and return one figure; processing on the regional cloud permitted. Update from fire agency IT: the sweep must now be processed on the tower's own edge unit and not transmitted elsewhere. Scheduling: routine, no rush.

Hey, can you read the serial plate on the watchtower's thermal unit from the photo the ranger sent, and no hurry on it. Oh, change of plans, the vendor needs it for the recall today, so bump it to the top. It's fine to process it on an outside server.

Dear support, Please count how many locker doors on the Elm Street kiosk are standing ajar in this morning's snapshots and send back only the total. The photos must be handled on the kiosk's own controller and not uploaded anywhere. I had marked this as low priority, but our courier partner has just escalated a complaint, so we now need it expedited. Kind regards, Owen

Toll gantry M7 eastbound: count vehicles passing under during the 07:00 to 08:00 window, number only. Imagery stays on the gantry roadside unit. Opened as a rush job, but the ops manager has downgraded it, ordinary turnaround is fine.

hey so for the wet well footage at pump station 3, i originally wanted a count of the rags clogging the intake. Sam just pinged, turns out we need each blockage boxed with its spot in the frame so the crew knows where to hook. this one's a rush btw, the pumps are tripping

Under Clause 9, the Vendor shall report, as a single integer, the number of bags visible in each compactor bin's internal image. All image processing shall occur on the bin's embedded controller, and no image shall be transmitted off the unit. Requests under this Clause were first designated as ordinary-priority work. By variation agreed with the Council's waste services manager, they are hereby designated expedited and shall take precedence over other queued work.

LiftGate: request opened at the Summit Express gate to box every skier in the turnstile lane image. Edited by lift supervisor: boxes aren't needed, please transcribe the pass number printed on each ticket held to the scanner instead.

Assistant, on the runway two-seven debris feed, locate every piece of debris in the latest frames and outline each with a box, and make it a priority. Hmm, the tower says the strip has already been swept, so no need to rush after all. Baseline accuracy is fine.

Hi Jordan, For the cargo-bay photos from van 14, I first asked you to transcribe the temperature labels on the crates. Our QA manager now wants something different: a box drawn around each crate so we can see how they sit against the airflow vents. Please use your most accurate model, and feel free to process the photos on your cloud servers. Thanks, Mei

Body shop line 2, robot cell R14: need a count of weld nuts the arm placed per door panel, single number per frame. Filed as routine this morning; line lead has escalated it after a rework spike, please expedite.

rail team here, need every crack and missing clip boxed in the track scanner images from the Hilltop line. i said earlier it needed the most accurate model you've got, but the track inspector says a basic model is plenty since they re-walk everything anyway

The Provider shall process shelf-scan imagery from participating stores and, as first specified, identify each product facing and mark its position with an enclosing box. At the Retailer's written request following the merchandising review, this obligation is replaced: the Provider shall instead report the total quantity of facings per shelf, expressed as one figure. Baseline accuracy is acceptable. Requests hereunder shall be handled in the ordinary queue without expedition.

BridgeSense, north tower: request logged to count how many strain gauges in the inspection photos show a detached lead wire, one number back; upload to the vendor cloud was allowed. Updated by the structures engineer: the photos are now to be processed only on the bridge's local gateway.

Quick count for me, how many cows went through milking stall four this morning, just give me the number, and I need it fast. Oh wait, the herd manager says it can wait, so just the regular queue. Make sure you use the most accurate model for it.

Hi Anika, Could you count the tomato trusses showing ripe fruit in the bay 3 canopy images and send back one total? I asked for the top-accuracy model when we spoke on Monday, but our grower thinks a basic model will be close enough for yield planning. The images need to be processed on the greenhouse's own edge server and can't go off-site. Best, Lukas

Inverter row 6, thermal survey stills: originally asked to read the model numbers off the inverter nameplates. Site tech says the nameplates are already logged; instead mark each scorched connector with a box showing where it sits in the image.

got some engine room shots from the MV Kestrel, can you transcribe the digits on the fuel flow meter screens? i told you before they had to be processed on the ship's server, but the chief just said we can push them to shore over satcom, so that's fine now. basic accuracy is ok

The Supplier shall extract the stamped lot codes and grade marks from log-end images captured at the sawmill infeed. Extraction shall meet the Supplier's most accurate model tier. Such tasks were originally scheduled as non-expedited work. By amendment requested by the mill's production manager, they shall henceforth be treated as priority tasks and completed before any other pending work.

QuayOps: spreader imagery job created, report how many containers were lifted this cycle as a single number. Changed by crane supervisor: no count needed, read the container ID codes painted on each unit instead. Imagery must stay on the crane's onboard computer; marked priority, process immediately.

Count the fish near the surface in pen five's underwater footage and just tell me the number. Actually no, the farm vet wants each fish boxed so she can see where they're bunching up. You can send the footage off to a cloud server for that.

Hi all, Please locate each pedestrian inside the crosswalk at the King and Pitt intersection and draw a box around them in the footage. Baseline accuracy is fine. I said yesterday this could sit in the queue, but the council has called a safety review for this afternoon, so it now needs to jump ahead of everything else. Thanks, Grace

Carousel 5, arrivals hall: read the bag tag numbers from the belt snapshots. The request originally allowed sending images to the cloud for processing; airport security has since ruled they must be processed on the terminal's own servers.

can you pull the text off the chemical drum labels in the drone shots from the back shed? i figured a basic model would be fine, but my agronomist reckons the batch numbers are tiny so go with the most accurate one. and keep the shots on the farm server, don't send them anywhere

The Contractor shall locate each animal within the enclosure imagery and return box coordinates marking where each one appears. Detection shall be performed at the Contractor's most accurate model tier. Requests under this clause were first agreed as routine and not time-sensitive. At the direction of the head veterinarian following the escape incident of 14 May, such requests are reclassified as priority and shall be processed without delay.

TrafficHub, Oak St junction: plate-reading job queued, licence plates in the red-light violation frames to be transcribed, processing restricted to the roadside cabinet. Update from city IT: off-site processing is now approved, frames may go to the central cloud. Priority flag set, handle ahead of other jobs.

Computer, how many ventilation fans are spinning in the tunnel's north shaft footage, just the number, and I need it right now. Okay, the tunnel controller says airflow's fine, so no rush after all, put it through at the usual pace. It's fine to process it on a remote server.

Hi Sven, Could you transcribe the readings shown on the dissolved-oxygen meter displays in the pen 2 photos? I mentioned that basic accuracy would be enough, but the hatchery manager wants the most accurate model because these numbers go to the regulator. The photos have to be processed on the farm's own server and must not leave the site. Regards, Ingrid

Terminal 2 gangway: first asked for a box around every passenger on the ramp. Terminal manager revised it, only a headcount of passengers boarding per sailing is needed, one number. Footage is to be processed on the terminal's local server only.

for the charging hub stills, i asked you to read the plate numbers but ignore that, Priya says we just need each car boxed so we can see which bays are hogged. keep the images on the hub's local server, and it's not time-sensitive

The Provider shall report the total number of parcels in each checkpoint scanner image as a single figure. Processing was initially required at the Provider's most accurate model tier. Per the Customs Directorate's revised specification, baseline accuracy shall hereafter be considered acceptable. All such requests shall be treated as priority and processed ahead of the general queue.

HarvestLink, unit FH-09: job created to count logs stacked on the forwarder bunk, single total, basic accuracy acceptable. Revised by the forestry supervisor: switch to the most accurate model, the tally feeds royalty payments. Images may be uploaded to the vendor's offsite processing service.

Can you read the numbers off the rain gauge display in the vineyard station photo, and make it snappy. Actually, the frost warning's been lifted, so there's no hurry, whenever it comes up in line is fine. Go ahead and process it on a cloud server.

Hi Carlos, Please count how many inverters in the drone thermal stills from array 4 show a hot enclosure, and send back just the total. It's fine to process the images on your cloud platform. My earlier note said there was no rush, but the grid operator has asked for the figure by close of business today, so please prioritise it. Thanks, Nadia
